literal: loyalty · filial piety · hard · both · complete
natural: loyalty and filial piety are hard to fulfil together

meaning.en: Duty to one's country and duty to one's parents often conflict, so one cannot fully satisfy both.
meaning.zh: 为国尽忠与在家尽孝常常冲突，很难同时做到。

examples.zh: 军人远在边疆，不能照顾父母，真是忠孝难两全。
examples.en: A soldier on the frontier cannot look after his parents; he truly cannot honour both duties.

examples.zh: 他放弃回乡探亲，选择留在抗灾一线，忠孝难两全。
examples.en: He gave up going home and stayed on the disaster front line, unable to serve both country and family.

usage.en: Used to express regret when public duty keeps someone from their family. The opposite wish is 忠孝两全.
usage.zh: 用于表达因公务而无法尽孝的无奈；相反的愿望是“忠孝两全”。

natural: exhaust the principles and fulfil the nature

meaning.en: To investigate the principles of things thoroughly and fully understand their nature.
meaning.zh: 彻底探究事物的道理，充分了解事物的本性。

equivalents: get to the bottom of things

examples.zh: 宋代理学家主张格物致知，穷理尽性。
examples.en: Song neo-Confucians advocated investigating things and exhausting their principles.

examples.zh: 做学问应当穷理尽性，不可浅尝辄止。
examples.en: Scholarship should probe to the root, not stop at a superficial taste.

story.en: The Commentary on the Appended Remarks of the Book of Changes says one should 'exhaust principle and fulfil nature, so as to reach destiny' (穷理尽性以至于命).
story.zh: 《周易·说卦》：“穷理尽性以至于命。”

date.zh: 战国至西汉 · 前3世纪—前2世纪（《易传》）
date.en: Warring States to Western Han, 3rd–2nd c. BC (Yi Zhuan)

usage.en: A scholarly term used in discussing philosophy and learning.
usage.zh: 学术用语，多用于谈论哲学和学问。

pinyin: bā gān zi dǎ bù zháo
natural: not reachable even with eight poles

meaning.en: So distant or unrelated that there is no connection at all.
meaning.zh: 形容距离很远，或关系疏远，毫不相干。

equivalents: nothing to do with each other

examples.zh: 他们两家八竿子打不着，怎么会是亲戚？
examples.en: The two families have nothing to do with each other; how could they be relatives?

examples.zh: 这个问题和我的专业八竿子打不着。
examples.en: This question is nowhere near my field.

usage.en: Colloquial; often said as 八竿子打不着的亲戚 for a very distant relative. Written variants are 八竿子打不到.
usage.zh: 口语，常说“八竿子打不着的亲戚”形容很远的亲戚。

pinyin: yī rì zhī jì zài yú chén
literal: one · day · 's · plan · lies · in · morning
natural: the day's plan lies in the morning

meaning.en: The morning is the key time of day for planning and getting started, so one should not waste it.
meaning.zh: 一天的计划要在早晨做好，应当珍惜清晨的时间。

equivalents: the early bird catches the worm

examples.zh: 一日之计在于晨，他每天五点就起床读书。
examples.en: The morning is the key to the day, so he gets up at five every day to read.

examples.zh: 一日之计在于晨，早点开始，下午就轻松多了。
examples.en: Start early, as the morning sets the pace for the day; the afternoon will be much easier.

usage.en: Often paired with 一年之计在于春. Used as encouragement to get up early and plan ahead.
usage.zh: 常与“一年之计在于春”连用，劝人早起、早做打算。

pinyin: xīn zhàng jiù zhàng yī qǐ suàn
literal: new · account · old · account · together · settle
natural: settle the new and old accounts together

meaning.en: To settle all grievances, new and old, at one time.
meaning.zh: 把新仇旧恨或新旧账目一并清算。

equivalents: settle old scores along with new ones
make someone pay for everything at once

examples.zh: 你这次又犯错，咱们就新账旧账一起算。
examples.en: You've made another mistake, so we'll settle both the new and the old accounts.

examples.zh: 房东说要新账旧账一起算，让他一次交清欠租。
examples.en: The landlord said he would settle all the old and new debts together and asked him to pay up the rent arrears in one go.

usage.en: Colloquial and threatening in tone; used when someone's past misdeeds are brought up all at once.
usage.zh: 口语，带威胁意味，指把过去的账一起清算。

meaning.en: All the neighbours living around one's home.

examples.zh: 她大声一喊，四邻八舍都听见了。
examples.en: She shouted loudly and all the neighbours heard.

examples.zh: 过年时，他给四邻八舍都送了年糕。
examples.en: At New Year he gave rice cakes to all the neighbours.

usage.en: Colloquial; used as subject or object. Numbers are not literal.
usage.zh: 口语，作主语或宾语；数字为虚指。

meaning.en: A false alarm; being frightened for nothing as the danger turns out to be nothing.
meaning.zh: 白白受了一场惊吓，实际上没有事。

examples.zh: 原来是风吹动了窗帘，虚惊一场。
examples.en: It was only the wind moving the curtain, a false alarm.

examples.zh: 体检结果一切正常，真是虚惊一场。
examples.en: The check-up results were all normal; it was just a false scare.

usage.en: Usually used as a closing comment after the danger has passed.
usage.zh: 多作事后总结的评语，作谓语。

meaning.en: Delicate and beautiful in illness, like the famous beauty Xishi; used of a frail beauty.
meaning.zh: 病弱时仍有西施般的动人风姿，形容体弱而美丽的女子。

examples.zh: 黛玉病如西子，常令人怜惜。
examples.en: Daiyu, frail yet beautiful like Xishi, always won people's sympathy.

examples.zh: 画中的女子病如西子，楚楚可怜。
examples.en: The woman in the painting is delicate and pitiable like Xishi.

origin.source: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第三回

story.en: Lin Daiyu is described as 'having one more orifice in her heart than Bi Gan, and, in her illness, surpassing Xishi by three parts' (心较比干多一窍，病如西子胜三分).
story.zh: 《红楼梦》第三回写林黛玉：“心较比干多一窍，病如西子胜三分。”

date.en: Qing dynasty, mid-18th c. (first eighty chapters)

usage.en: Literary; mainly used of Lin Daiyu or similar frail beauties. In the original line, 病如西子胜三分 says her illness surpasses Xishi's by a margin.
usage.zh: 文学用语，多形容林黛玉一类体弱的美人；原句为“病如西子胜三分”。

meaning.en: To push the blame for one's own mistakes onto other people.

examples.zh: 出了问题就诿过于人，这样的领导没人信服。
examples.en: A leader who blames others whenever something goes wrong convinces nobody.

examples.zh: 他从不诿过于人，总是先检讨自己。
examples.en: He never shifts the blame and always examines himself first.

usage.en: Formal, written; used as predicate. Opposite of 引咎自责.
usage.zh: 书面语，作谓语；与“引咎自责”相对。

literal: same · trade · mutually · look down on
natural: people in the same trade look down on one another

meaning.en: People in the same profession tend to belittle one another's work.
meaning.zh: 同一行业的人往往互相看不起。

examples.zh: 同行相轻本是人之常情，但我们应当互相学习。
examples.en: Professional jealousy is only human, but we should learn from each other.

examples.zh: 这两位画家同行相轻，多年不来往。
examples.en: These two painters look down on each other and haven't been in touch for years.

usage.en: Used as predicate or a general remark; often linked to 文人相轻.
usage.zh: 作谓语或泛论，常与“文人相轻”相联系。

meaning.en: Armoured cavalry and icy rivers; a picture of the hardships and heroism of warfare in the northern frontier.
meaning.zh: 披甲的战马和冰封的河流，形容北方边塞的战争场景和豪迈气概。

equivalents: the clang of cavalry and ice

examples.zh: 读了陆游的诗，我仿佛看到了铁马冰河的战场。
examples.en: Reading Lu You's poem, I seemed to see the battlefield of iron horses and frozen rivers.

examples.zh: 纪录片再现了铁马冰河的抗战岁月。
examples.en: The documentary recreates the harsh years of war of resistance.

origin.source: 宋·陆游《十一月四日风雨大作》

story.en: Lu You wrote that in his dream, 'iron horses and icy rivers' came to him on a stormy night (夜阑卧听风吹雨，铁马冰河入梦来), expressing his longing to recover the north.
story.zh: 陆游：“夜阑卧听风吹雨，铁马冰河入梦来。”

usage.en: Literary and stirring; usually used as an attributive or object when describing battles or patriotic ambition.
usage.zh: 文学性强、气势雄浑，多作定语或宾语，描写战争或爱国壮志。

meaning.en: To imagine that someone is fond of one, or to show affection that is not returned.
meaning.zh: 一厢情愿地对别人有好感，或误以为别人对自己有意。

examples.zh: 人家只是礼貌地笑笑，你别自作多情了。
examples.en: She was just smiling politely, so don't flatter yourself.

examples.zh: 他以为她喜欢自己，其实是自作多情。
examples.en: He thought she liked him, but it was just wishful thinking.

usage.en: Colloquial, mocking or self-mocking; usually refers to love but also to presuming favour.
usage.zh: 口语，带嘲讽或自嘲意味，多指感情，也可指错误地以为被看重。

natural: there is no fixed teacher in learning

meaning.en: To learn from anyone who has something to teach, rather than just one fixed teacher.
meaning.zh: 学习不限于固定的老师，谁有长处就向谁学习。

examples.zh: 他学无常师，广泛向各派名家求教。
examples.en: He learned from many sources and sought advice from masters of every school.

examples.zh: 学无常师，只要有长处，我都愿意请教。
examples.en: There is no fixed teacher in learning; I'm happy to consult anyone with strengths.

usage.en: Used as predicate or maxim; praises open-mindedness in study.
usage.zh: 作谓语或格言，赞扬虚心好学。

meaning.en: Poor at speaking; unable to express oneself fluently.

examples.zh: 我拙嘴笨腮的，不知怎么向你道谢。
examples.en: I'm no good with words and don't know how to thank you.

examples.zh: 他拙嘴笨腮，让他上台发言真是难为他了。
examples.en: He is a poor speaker, so asking him to speak on stage is really putting him on the spot.

usage.en: Often self-deprecating; used as predicate. Close in sense to the more common 笨嘴拙舌.
usage.zh: 常用于自谦，作谓语；与“笨嘴拙舌”意思相近。

meaning.en: A person with promising talent who is worth training.
meaning.zh: 有培养前途、值得造就的人才。

examples.zh: 老师认为这个孩子是可造之才。
examples.en: The teacher considers the child a promising talent.

examples.zh: 他年纪虽轻，却是公司公认的可造之才。
examples.en: Though young, he is regarded in the company as someone worth developing.

usage.en: Used as object or predicate, often in references and evaluations by seniors.
usage.zh: 多作宾语或谓语，常见于长辈或上级的评价。

meaning.en: By the age of forty one should have established one's career and beliefs.
meaning.zh: 人到四十岁，应当在事业和见识上有所成就、站稳脚跟。

examples.zh: 四十而立，他终于开了自己的公司。
examples.en: At forty, he finally set up his own company.

examples.zh: 人们常说四十而立，可我还在摸索方向。
examples.en: They say one should be established at forty, but I am still looking for direction.

usage.en: A modern saying based on the Analects, which actually says 三十而立 (at thirty, to stand firm) and 四十而不惑 (at forty, free from doubt); 四十而立 is a common rewording.
usage.zh: 此语由《论语》“三十而立，四十而不惑”演化而来，现代口语中多指四十岁应有所成就。

natural: telling a dream within a dream

meaning.en: To speak of illusions while still in a state of illusion; empty, unreal talk.
meaning.zh: 在梦里说梦话，比喻说话虚幻、不真实或没有觉悟。

examples.zh: 他说的那些宏图大计，不过是梦中说梦。
examples.en: The grand plans he describes are no more than a dream within a dream.

examples.zh: 不认清现实，只会梦中说梦。
examples.en: Without facing reality, one only talks dreams in a dream.

usage.en: Literary, often with a Buddhist flavour; used as predicate or as a comment.
usage.zh: 文学性较强，带佛家色彩，作谓语或评语。

natural: hooking shoulders and leaning on backs

meaning.en: To walk or stand with arms around each other's shoulders, as very close friends do; sometimes seen as unseemly.
meaning.zh: 互相搭着肩膀和后背，形容关系亲密，有时含举止不庄重之意。

examples.zh: 几个同学勾肩搭背地走出校门。
examples.en: A few classmates walked out of the school gate with their arms around each other.

examples.zh: 这对老朋友勾肩搭背，有说有笑。
examples.en: The two old friends, arm in arm, chatted and laughed.

usage.en: Colloquial; as a predicate or adverbial. Can be affectionate or mildly disapproving depending on context.
usage.zh: 口语，作谓语或状语，可亲昵也可略带贬义，视语境而定。
